explanation: gap-resolver runs SEMI-AUTOMATIC by policy (GAP_RESOLVER_AUTO unset): a bounds-pass candidate is logged as would-run and DEFERRED for approval — the matched logs/gap-resolution.jsonl row shows autoExecuted=false. Deferral is the designed decision path (approval stays behind the S5 surface), not a shadow error.

shadow_cycle runner is record-only by contract: it appends candidates to the ledger and never applies anything, so a would-run finding whose fix has not landed yet is deferral by design, not divergence.
